findings.current: His only family in the world had died here.
findings.defect: “Family” loses Jeok Cheongang’s specific claim that the dead man was his only blood relative.
findings.rationale: 피붙이 specifically means a blood relative.
findings.replacement: His only blood relative had died here.

findings.current: Even after nearly ten years had passed, he still hadn’t made peace with what happened.
findings.defect: The draft turns his realization that he was still not emotionally prepared into a claim that he had not accepted the past.
findings.rationale: 마음의 준비를 끝내지 못했다 concerns readiness; the source leaves what he is preparing himself for implicit.
findings.replacement: Even after nearly ten years, he still wasn’t ready.
findings.source: 어언 십 년의 세월이 지났음에도, 그는 여전히 마음의 준비를 끝내지 못했다는 것을.

findings.current: A vicious little brat who had wandered the world in the distant past, not even knowing his own name.
findings.defect: “Vicious” makes the young Jeok Cheongang cruel rather than fiercely tenacious, and the draft omits his begging for food.
findings.rationale: 독기 describes his hard-edged determination here; 유리걸식 specifies wandering and begging for food.
findings.replacement: A fiercely determined little boy who had wandered the world long ago, begging for food without even knowing his own name.
findings.source: 까마득한 옛날, 제 이름조차 알지 못한 채 세상을 떠돌며 유리걸식하던 독기 가득한 꼬마를.

findings.current: With those words, inaudible to anyone, Jeok Cheongang threw a single punch.
findings.defect: “Inaudible to anyone” adds a universal claim where the source only says the words would not be heard.
findings.rationale: The line addresses the disciple Jeok Cheongang is letting go; it does not establish that nobody could hear him.
findings.replacement: With those words, which Jangcheon would never hear, Jeok Cheongang threw a single punch.
findings.source: 들리지 않을 그 한마디와 함께, 적천강은 일권(一拳)을 뻗었다.

findings.current: two gazes met in the empty space between them.
findings.defect: The draft drops the handspan separating their faces at the moment their eyes meet.
findings.rationale: 한 뼘 gives the distance explicitly.
findings.replacement: two gazes met across the handspan of empty space between them.
findings.source: 두 개의 시선이 한 뼘 사이의 허공에서 얽혀들었다.

findings.current: The foul stench and smell of blood that had been rumbling all around him faded
findings.defect: “Rumbling” describes an audible vibration rather than odors filling the air.
findings.rationale: 진동하던 describes how pervasively the smells hung in the air, not a sound they made.
findings.replacement: Every foul odor and the reek of blood that had filled the air around him faded
findings.source: 사방에서 진동하던 온갖 악취와 피비린내가 희미해지고

summary: The draft preserves the scene’s main action, but changes a kinship claim and several details of Jeok Cheongang’s memories and realization.
